definitions.bss: 1 - model BS / shared 2021-2023 monthly reference BS on identical pairs
definitions.crps: Complete analytical CSGD CRPS, including signed-shift term
definitions.event: Strict observation > threshold; CSI uses expected precipitation > threshold
definitions.expected_precipitation: Mean of final censored shifted gamma distribution
definitions.reliability: Ten equal-width probability bins; final bin includes one
definitions.roc_auc: Exact empirical rank AUC with half credit for ties, including cross-lead ties
definitions.roc_display: Empirical rates on 1001 fixed cutoffs from 1 to 0 plus none/all endpoints; display grid is not used for AUC
definitions.scope: Fixed thresholds only; no ARI scores, uncertainty intervals or significance claims
definitions.undefined_metrics: JSON null / CSV empty when denominator zero or correlation/ROC class unavailable
definitions.weighting: Equal weight per retained grid-point/window pair

metadata.checkpoint_note: Frozen GEFS and corrected HRRR research checkpoints selected using 2024 validation CRPS. Issued operational checkpoint versions are separate.
metadata.reference_note: Both systems use the same frozen monthly MRMS event-frequency reference from available 2021–2023 observations, with unique valid windows and no 2025 data.
metadata.sample_note: Daily 00 UTC initializations in 2025; common 0.25° CONUS land grid, 13,318 cells, matched windows through 48 h. Valid endings outside 2025 excluded. Overlapping windows and spatial pairs are dependent examples.
metadata.score_units: CRPS/MAE/RMSE/bias: mm; probabilities and skill scores: fractions.
metadata.secondary_diagnostics: Precision, POD, FAR, F1, ETS, frequency bias, ECE and binned Brier components are derived after the core annual evaluation. The original-BS binning residual is retained.
metadata.title: Full-year 2025 research evaluation
metadata.training_note: GEFS: 2021–2023 for all durations. HRRR: 2021–2023 for 6 h, 2020–2023 for 12/24 h. This compares fitted systems rather than isolating forecast-source effects.
